headline: Strong quarter beats across the board; guidance raised
summary_short: Revenue rose to $4.87B (+7% y/y, +7% q/q) as adjusted segment EBITA margin expanded 140bp to 28.5%; GAAP EPS rose 23% y/y to $1.28 and management raised full-year 2026 guidance on strong orders and cash flow.
summary_long: Revenue grew 7% y/y and 7% q/q to $4.87B, with pretax margin up 270bp y/y to 18.8% on higher adjusted segment EBITA margin (28.5%, +140bp). GAAP EPS rose 23% y/y to $1.28; adjusted EPS rose 13% to $1.71. Underlying orders grew 7% and underlying sales grew 6%, led by Software & Systems (Test & Measurement +23%) and broad growth in North America and Asia. Operating cash flow rose 34% y/y to $1.43B and free cash flow rose 36% to $1.32B. Cash climbed to $2.18B while long-term debt fell to $7.53B. Management raised full-year 2026 guidance, citing strong Q3 performance and healthy demand, and reiterated plans to return ~$2.2B to shareholders in FY2026.

drivers.explanation: Underlying orders rose 7%, led by Software & Systems and broad-based growth in North America and Asia; Test & Measurement segment sales +23%.
GAAP EPS included a one-off $82M pretax IEEPA tariff refund (about $0.11/share), which is excluded from adjusted EPS of $1.71.
Adjusted segment EBITA margin expanded 140bp to 28.5% on higher underlying sales across Intelligent Devices and Software & Systems segments.
CEO cited robust demand and secular automation tailwinds behind raising full-year 2026 guidance, while flagging the Middle East conflict as an ongoing fluid risk.
